relationships.subject: Utidelone
relationships.evidence_quote: The present investigation built a mouse pain model induced by UTD1, resulting in marked mechanical and cold allodynia.

relationships.subject: Utidelone
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed a significant elevation in TRPA1 mRNA expression in DRGs by the 7th day post-UTD1 treatment

relationships.subject: HC-030031
relationships.evidence_quote: The TRPA1 antagonist HC-030031, resulted in the alleviation of mechanical and cold allodynia in the UTD1-induced pain model

relationships.subject: Mito-tempo
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that Mito-tempo, a mitochondria-targeted antioxidant, can ameliorate peripheral neuropathic pain in mice.

key_findings: Utidelone induces mechanical and cold (not heat) allodynia in mice with TRPA1 upregulation in DRG at day 7, while TRPV1 and TRPV4 were unchanged.
TRPA1 antagonist HC-030031 and antioxidants Mito-tempo and edaravone reversed UTD1-induced allodynia.
